name: Grameenphone.
description: This is a schema-only example organization for the analyst workbench. It models a K-12 learning platform with offline sync notes so new analysts can copy the field names without inventing a live company record.
innovation_rationale: Shipped adaptive lesson plans used by 120 schools in Jakarta since 2024.
market_traction_rationale: Reported 40% YoY revenue growth and 50,000 active student users in 2025.
competitiveness_rationale: Only local LMS with Bahasa-first content aligned to the national K-12 curriculum.
product_depth_rationale: Offers LMS, parent portal, and offline mobile sync across 3 product tiers.
social_proof_rationale: Winner of EdTech Asia 2025 Best K-12 Platform award in Singapore.
